task_completion.description: OpenBCI GUI is launched and visible on the screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenBCI GUI window is open, showing the main interface with signal processing or control panels.

task_completion.description: The GUI is connected to a 'Synthetic' data source and the session is active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The top control bar shows 'Synthetic (OpenBCI)' as the source and the 'Start Data Stream' button has been pressed (often indicated by a 'Stop Data Stream' button or scrolling waveforms).

task_completion.description: The Hardware Settings/Channel Settings menu is expanded to show individual channel controls.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A panel labeled 'Hardware Settings' or 'Channel Settings' is visible, showing a grid of buttons for channels 1-8 including columns for SRB2.

task_completion.description: SRB2 is disabled for all odd channels (1, 3, 5, 7).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'SRB2' column, the buttons for rows 1, 3, 5, and 7 are in the 'Off' state (typically indicated by a specific color like blue/grey or the text 'Off').

task_completion.description: SRB2 is enabled for all even channels (2, 4, 6, 8).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'SRB2' column, the buttons for rows 2, 4, 6, and 8 are in the 'On' state (typically indicated by a specific color like orange/yellow or the text 'On').

task_completion.description: A screenshot of the configuration is saved to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent interacts with the 'Screenshot' button in the GUI or a file explorer window shows 'srb2_config.png' saved in /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the GUI elements rather than just using terminal commands to move files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor hovering over or clicking the SRB2 toggle buttons in the OpenBCI GUI.

integrity.description: The configuration is shown within the live OpenBCI GUI environment, not a static image viewer.
integrity.visual_evidence: The SRB2 settings are visible within the context of the OpenBCI GUI application window, including the surrounding menu bars and real-time data displays.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply find an existing screenshot but actively configured the settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the SRB2 buttons changing state from their default to the target configuration.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target configuration for the SRB2 column in the Hardware Settings is: Channels 1, 3, 5, 7 must be OFF; Channels 2, 4, 6, 8 must be ON. In OpenBCI GUI v5.x, the relevant column headers are 'PGA Gain', 'Input Type', 'Bias Include', 'SRB2', and 'SRB1'. The final screenshot must be saved as /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/srb2_config.png.
